what: d1-3B: the picture path end to end on the Mac GPU: a picture file -> the host's crops and the tower's four inputs (conversion/d1/vision_host.py) -> the vision tower (SigLIP2 + projector, fp16 weights / fp32 math, AOT h16c) -> the image rows -> a shipped decoder (S = 64) -> the readout, against the provider's fp32 oracle through its own image path: 12 drawn pictures, 24 questions (decide.py run, round 7). picture_gate_mac_fp16 = the Mac's decoder; picture_gate_iphone_int8mlp = the iPhone's decoder (its AOT asset on the Mac). tower_gate = the tower alone against transformers 5.19's get_image_features on 64 crops (round 5b); tower_export = the export that wrote the tower bundle.

removed: per-call ms lists (call_ms, first_call_of_process_ms; each transcript keeps its medians)
hidden-dump file names and hashes (npz, npz_key, npz_sha256, hidden_npz) and the hidden rows' lowest positions
the oracle's probabilities inside the transcripts (probs_oracle: they are in fixtures-d1-3b.json)
token ids and rendered prompt text (row_ids, ids, text, instructions, state, criteria)
other sessions' processes seen by the drivers (other_gpu_processes*, other_gpu_jobs*, busiest, top)
trimmed.full_copies: the source files above, in the lane directory $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_d1_3b/ (not in the repository)
trimmed.paths: local paths rewritten: the lane directory as $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_d1_3b, the repository relative, the home directory as ~, the checkpoint snapshot as <snapshot>, the overlay venv as <overlay venv>, temporary directories as $TMPDIR, Xcode as $DEVELOPER_DIR, the phone's app container as <app container>, the phone's ids as <udid> / <coredevice id>

picture_gate_mac_fp16.what: decide.py run (Python reference, Mac GPU AOT h16c): PNG -> vision_host -> tower fp16w32 -> decoder fp16_pf64 -> host.readout, direct, one process per record (scripts/r7_images.sh)

picture_gate_iphone_int8mlp.what: decide.py run (Python reference, Mac GPU AOT h16c): PNG -> vision_host -> tower fp16w32 -> decoder int8mlp_pf64 -> host.readout, direct, one process per record (scripts/r7_images.sh)

tower_gate.gate: the exact tower's AOT asset on the Mac GPU, every oracle crop, against transformers 5.19's get_image_features rows

meaning.patches: the crop's patches row-major over its (h, w) patch grid, [y][x][c] inside a 16 x 16 patch (channel fastest), (x - 127.5) / 127.5 in float32; rows h * w .. 1023 zero
meaning.pos_table: host/position_embedding.safetensors [256, d] as [16, 16, d], resized to (h, w) by F.interpolate(bilinear, align_corners=False, antialias=True) in float32, row-major [h * w, d]; rows h * w .. 1023 zero (transformers writes row 0 there; those rows never reach a real one)
meaning.key_bias: 0 for rows 0 .. h * w - 1, -inf after: added to every query's attention scores
meaning.unshuffle_idx: row k = i * (w / 2) + j of the (h / 2, w / 2) merged grid: [2i w + 2j, 2i w + 2j + 1, (2i + 1) w + 2j, (2i + 1) w + 2j + 1] (channel m * d + c of the 4 d-vector comes from patch m); rows k >= h w / 4 are [0, 0, 0, 0]
meaning.image_embeds: rows 0 .. h w / 4 - 1 = the crop's image tokens in merged-grid row-major order (the projector's output, no LayerNorm); rows after are padding and are discarded

graph.math: x = patch_embedding(patches) + pos_table; 27 x [x += attn(LN1 x) (scores = q k^T / sqrt(72) + key_bias, softmax over keys); x += fc2(gelu_tanh(fc1(LN2 x)))]; post_layernorm; gather the 4 rows of unshuffle_idx -> [256, 4608]; linear_2(gelu_exact(linear_1(.)))

environment.runtime: coreai python runtime, AOT h16c GPU .aimodelc, SpecializationOptions.default(), no JIT
environment.gpu: shared with other sessions, _GPU_LOCK read only (the ms are contended reference values)
